# GetSkillRoadmap (Knowledge Base & Accreditation Engine)

> Independent audits, technical syllabi benchmarks, and proof-of-work roadmaps for high-value tech certifications, engineering paths, and remote careers. Written and audited by Eren Şimşir (Founder, Editor & Software Engineer).

## Editorial Mission
GetSkillRoadmap.com is an independent digital research and career evaluation platform founded to demystify professional credentials, online certifications, and self-taught engineering paths.

## Primary Verification Tracks
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://getskillroadmap.com/category/cloud-devops/): AWS, Azure, and infrastructure credential audits
- [Cybersecurity](https://getskillroadmap.com/category/cybersecurity/): CompTIA Security+, defensive engineering, and SOC roadmaps
- [Data & AI](https://getskillroadmap.com/category/data-ai/): Analytics, Machine Learning, and prompt engineering blueprints
- [Software Engineering](https://getskillroadmap.com/category/software-engineering/): Frontend, backend, bootcamps vs self-taught reality
- [Management & Strategy](https://getskillroadmap.com/category/management-business/): PMP, Scrum, Lean Six Sigma, and Product Management
- [Career Strategy](https://getskillroadmap.com/category/career-tactics/): Resume ATS filters, remote work credentials, and credential verification

## Interactive Tools
- [Certification ROI Estimator](https://getskillroadmap.com/roi-calculator/): Free benchmark calculator comparing exam costs, prep time, and salary lift.

## Certification Audits & Technical Roadmaps (25 In-Depth Guides)
- [10 Free Globally Recognized Certifications from Tech Giants (Google, Harvard, Cisco)](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/free-globally-recognized-certifications/): A curated directory of 10 completely free, verified certifications from Google, Harvard University, Cisco, Microsoft, and HubSpot without paywalls or hidden fees.
- [AWS Cloud Practitioner Study Guide (CLF-C02): Pass on Your First Try](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/aws-cloud-practitioner-clf-c02-study-guide/): A comprehensive syllabus breakdown, domain weight analysis, and 30-day tactical study plan to pass the updated AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 exam.
- [AZ-900 Study Guide: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals Syllabus & Exam Strategy](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/azure-fundamentals-az-900-exam-guide/): Master Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900). A detailed review of official Microsoft Learn pathways, cloud governance scenarios, pricing models, and first-attempt exam tactics.
- [Best Product Management Certifications: Product School vs. AIPMM vs. Pragmatic](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/best-product-management-certifications/): An empirical audit of Product School (PMC), AIPMM (CPMM), and Pragmatic Institute. Evaluating PRD creation, product metrics, and live prototype deliverables.
- [CFI FMVA Review: Is This Financial Modeling Certification Worth the Money?](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/cfi-fmva-financial-modeling-certification-review/): A comprehensive audit of the Corporate Finance Institute (CFI) Financial Modeling & Valuation Analyst (FMVA) certification. DCF modeling, M&A cases, and investment banking ROI.
- [Coding Bootcamps vs. Self-Taught Developer: Cost, ISAs, and Placement Realities](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/coding-bootcamps-vs-self-taught-path/): An exhaustive investigation into coding bootcamps vs self-directed learning in 2026. Income Share Agreement (ISA) financial traps, employer sentiment, and open-source portfolio proof.
- [DeepLearning.AI Specialization by Andrew Ng: Math Prerequisites & Code Depth](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/deeplearning-ai-specialization-andrew-ng-review/): An academic and engineering audit of Andrew Ng's Deep Learning Specialization. Matrix calculus prerequisites, NumPy neural networks from scratch, and Transformer models.
- [Duolingo English Test (DET) vs. IELTS vs. TOEFL: Cost, Acceptance, and Security](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/duolingo-english-test-vs-ielts-vs-toefl/): An exhaustive comparison of the Duolingo English Test (DET), IELTS, and TOEFL iBT. Evaluating AI proctoring rules, CEFR score equivalencies, and university/visa acceptance rates.
- [Google Cybersecurity vs. CompTIA Security+: Head-to-Head Comparison](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/google-cybersecurity-vs-comptia-security-plus/): A direct comparison of the Google Cybersecurity Certificate and CompTIA Security+. Evaluating hands-on SIEM skills, ANSI accreditation, and the 30% discount coupon strategy.
- [Google Data Analytics Certificate Review: Real Hiring Value & ROI](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/google-data-analytics-certificate-review/): An in-depth technical audit of the Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate. Evaluating R vs. Python, Coursera financial aid, portfolio capstones, and recruiter perception.
- [Google Project Management Certificate: Does It Truly Count Toward CAPM?](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/google-project-management-certificate-review/): Audit of the Google Project Management Professional Certificate on Coursera. Evaluating 100+ PMI PDU equivalents, Asana workflows, and entry-level hiring viability.
- [Google UX Design Certificate: From Novice to a 3-Project Figma Portfolio](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/google-ux-design-certificate-figma-portfolio/): An exhaustive audit of the Google UX Design Professional Certificate. User research methodologies, Figma design systems, usability testing, and Behance case study formatting.
- [How to List Certifications on Your Resume to Pass Enterprise ATS Filters](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/how-to-list-certifications-on-resume-ats/): The definitive technical guide to formatting professional certifications for Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS). Credential ID formats, LinkedIn licensing sections, and placement hierarchy.
- [How to Pass Professional Scrum Master I (PSM I): 85% Passing Blueprint](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/pass-psm-1-scrum-master-first-attempt/): The definitive blueprint to passing Scrum.org Professional Scrum Master I (PSM I) on your first try. Scrum Guide trap questions, open assessment tactics, and lifetime validity.
- [How to Spot Unaccredited Certificates & Degree Mills: 5 Verification Checks](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/how-to-verify-authentic-certifications/): A consumer protection guide to identifying counterfeit diplomas, fake certification registries, unaccredited course mills, and verifying Credly ID authenticity.
- [IBM Data Science Professional Certificate Audit: Python, SQL & Scikit-Learn](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/ibm-data-science-professional-certificate-review/): A comprehensive audit of the 10-course IBM Data Science Professional Certificate. Python vs R comparison with Google, Watson Studio labs, and machine learning depth.
- [Lean Six Sigma Yellow vs. Green Belt: Certification Scope & DMAIC](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/lean-six-sigma-yellow-vs-green-belt/): An operational audit of Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt vs Green Belt. Evaluating DMAIC phases, Minitab statistical analysis, and IASSC vs ASQ accreditation bodies.
- [Meta Front-End Developer Certificate: Portfolio & Job Market Audit](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/meta-front-end-developer-certificate-review/): A technical review of Meta's Front-End Developer Professional Certificate on Coursera. Dissecting the React modules, GitHub Capstone, and Meta Job Board hiring access.
- [No-Code Automation Specialist Career Guide: Make & Zapier Certification](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/no-code-automation-specialist-career-guide/): How to build a high-income consulting career using Make (Integromat) and Zapier. Mastering webhooks, REST APIs, JSON data parsing, and $75+/hr freelancing contracts.
- [PMP vs. CAPM: Experience Thresholds, Exam Costs, and Salary Impact](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/pmp-vs-capm-certification-comparison/): A rigorous comparison of PMI Project Management Professional (PMP) and Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM). Audit rules, PMBOK 7 changes, and salary data.
- [Power BI (PL-300) vs. Tableau Certified Analyst: Enterprise Demand Comparison](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/power-bi-pl-300-vs-tableau-data-analyst/): A head-to-head enterprise audit of Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300) and Tableau Certified Data Analyst. Comparing DAX vs LOD expressions, market share, and license ROI.
- [Prompt Engineering & AI Certifications: Valid Technical Skills vs. Hype](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/prompt-engineering-generative-ai-certifications/): Auditing Generative AI and Prompt Engineering credentials. Differentiating superficial text prompting from production RAG architecture, few-shot prompting, and evaluation benchmarks.
- [Security+ Study Guide (SY0-701): Roadmap from Zero to SOC Analyst](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/comptia-security-plus-sy0-701-roadmap/): A complete tactical roadmap to passing CompTIA Security+ SY0-701. Performance-Based Questions (PBQ) strategies, DoD 8570 compliance, CEU costs, and practical SIEM labs.
- [The Certificate Trap: Escaping Tutorial Hell & Building Proof-of-Work](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/escaping-certificate-trap-tutorial-hell/): Why collecting dozens of certification badges triggers recruiter skepticism, how to break free from tutorial hell, and the definitive Proof-of-Work engineering methodology.
- [Top 7 Globally Accredited Certifications for High-Paying Remote Roles](https://getskillroadmap.com/guides/international-certifications-for-remote-jobs/): An analysis of ISO/IEC 17024 accredited certifications that enable international engineers to secure high-paying USD/EUR remote contracts and bypass local degree bias.
